name: Open Dishguard
description: Raise the sabre overhead and bring the edge straight down onto the target in one line.

name: Knucklebar Husk
description: Lay the blunt spine across the forearm and brace the blade crosswise to stop a descending blow.

name: Light Brush
description: Slide the lead foot forward and drag the rear foot after it while holding the point low.

name: Dragcut Strike
description: Drag the curved belly of the blade across the target while stepping back to lengthen the cut.

name: Angled Spineback
description: Turn the wrist outward so the flat of the blade knocks aside an incoming thrust or cut.

name: Brushblow
description: Swing the sabre from above the head in a heavy arc and let its weight fall through the target.

name: Sudden Swathe
description: Flick the curved belly upward from a low hold to cut the target under the chin or arm.

name: Angled Tipbend
description: Cross the free forearm over the sabre hand and take a blow on the braced spine.

name: Easing Curvespine
description: Slip one pace sideways off the line of attack and bring the blade round to face the foe.

name: Ready Ringpommel
description: Brush the flat of the blade inward across the body to sweep a cut off its line.

name: Keen Bellyblade
description: Swing the blade flat and level at waist height with the hips turning to drive the edge through.

name: Swathestrike
description: Drop the edge in a plumb line from the shoulder with the body behind the stroke.

name: Brushhit
description: Hew from the high shoulder down across the target's opposite hip with a full turn of the torso.

name: Blunt Rearedge
description: Bring the blade back across the body on the opposite diagonal at once after the first hew.

name: Chopbelly Husk
description: Catch a falling blow on the spine with the off hand pressed flat behind the blade.

name: Holding Flatside
description: Hook the wrist under an incoming blade and let it slide off the curve of the sabre.

name: Whisk Amble
description: Close the distance in two firm paces so the next chop lands at full reach.

name: Square Scrape
description: Chop and bring the blade back to guard in one beat so a second chop can follow without delay.

name: Backward Slice
description: Spin on the rear heel to turn the whole body and sabre to face a new attacker.

name: Backward Whisk
description: Trace a crescent with the lead foot to circle round a foe while the blade stays pointed at them.

name: Chopskitter
description: Take a measured pace backward with the sabre held across the body to give ground safely.

name: Flatside Drop
description: Sink into a wide low stance and hew at the knees or thighs of the target.

name: Short Chopbelly
description: Step past the target while drawing the belly of the blade along its side in a long slice.

name: Settled Dishguard
description: Pivot away and drop the blade behind the back to cover the rear as the body turns.

name: Blunt Bellyblade
description: Spring from a settled guard straight into a cut along the same line without a wind-up.

name: Resting Spineback
description: Hold the blade flat above the head to take a falling blow and shed it to either side.

name: Bevellid
description: Hold the blade upright beside the ribs so a side cut meets the spine first.

name: Lowered Rearedge
description: Sweep the flat of the sabre across an incoming blade and push it wide of the body.

name: Bevelblow
description: Duck under a wide swing and cut upward into the arm that threw it.

name: Swatheskitter
description: Shift the hips out of the path of a cut or thrust and keep both feet planted.

name: Brushbump
description: Roll the wrist to carry the blade round in a small circle and cut at the end of it.

name: Iron Brush
description: Chop from a rooted stance with both feet fixed so all force comes from hips and shoulders.

name: Swatheblow
description: Whip the narrow blade out with a loose wrist so the tip snaps across the target like a switch.

name: Narrow Curvespine
description: Slice shallow along the target with the narrow belly of the blade in a quick drawing stroke.

name: Settled Ringpommel
description: Tap an incoming blade aside with a light turn of the hand rather than meeting its weight.

name: Choppause
description: Dip the point toward the ground and hold the blade slanted so low cuts glance away.

name: Light Knucklebar
description: Drift two quick light steps to one side so the foe must turn to follow.

name: Scrape Hit
description: Release the breath as the sabre falls and let a small pulse of qi ride the edge into the target.

name: Square Swathe
description: Skim a thin film of qi along the belly while drawing the blade slowly through the target.

name: Tight Rearedge
description: Meet a blow on the spine with a short pulse of qi so the blade rings and holds.

name: Skipping Dragcut
description: Move one measured pace on an out-breath and keep the sabre hand level and calm.

name: Raised Bellyblade
description: Circle the blade with a thread of qi trailing it and turn an incoming cut off its line.

name: Brushstrike
description: Chop on a sharp exhale and drive a little qi into the edge at the instant of contact.

name: Dishdash
description: Slash with a bright thin line of qi laid along the edge to deepen the cut.

name: Slicehit
description: Slash upward from a low hold with qi along the belly to lift the foe's guard.

name: Planted Dishguard
description: Wrap the blade in a close sheath of qi and hold it across the body against a cut.

name: Bevelamble
description: Lighten the feet with qi and skip a short pace to change the angle of approach.

name: Tight Tipbend
description: Slip the blade past an attack and turn with it so the foe's force runs on past.

name: Slicebump
description: Hew twice on one breath with qi laid along the edge on each stroke.

name: Open Swathe
description: Carry the slash on through the target and bring the blade back to guard with the same pulse.

name: Open Flatside
description: Drop the broad weighted blade with qi sharpening the edge so its mass bites deep.

name: Stout Ringpommel
description: Hew across with the wide belly of the blade so it cleaves a broad strip from the target.

name: Forward Scrape
description: Sweep the heavy blade round behind the body and let its weight carry it through a wide arc.

name: Dishcowl
description: Brace the thick spine with both hands and a pulse of qi to hold against a hard blow.

name: Slicehop
description: Step into the swing of the heavy blade and let its momentum pull the body forward.

name: Raised Spineback
description: Swing the heavy blade across an incoming weapon so its mass bats the weapon aside.

name: Knucklebar Strike
description: Roll the heavy blade through a wide circle with qi held along it and slash at the end.

name: Snug Tipbend
description: Pull the pommel back to bring the heavy blade home to guard after a missed swing.

name: Whisk Hit
description: Lead the stroke with the sharp edge and slice with a thread of qi along it.

name: Chopbelly Hit
description: Rap the blunt spine against the hand or wrist of a foe to numb it without cutting.

name: Ready Curvespine
description: Turn the blade over mid-parry so the spine takes the blow and the edge faces the foe.

name: Choplid
description: Press the flat against the forearm and hold the blade tilted to take a slash.

name: Dishamble
description: Slip through a narrow gap between two attackers with the blade drawn tight to the body.

name: Narrow Slice
description: Drive the hew from the shoulder with a pulse of qi running down the arm into the edge.

name: Straight Dragcut
description: Let the elbow swing loose so the blade whips into the chop with extra speed.

name: Kept Curvespine
description: Lock the forearm against the hilt and hold the blade rigid to stop a heavy cut.

name: Chophusk
description: Sweep the whole arm in an arc so the blade carries an attack out and away.

name: Flat Flatside
description: Extend the arm fully into a slash that reaches a pace beyond the foe's guard.

name: Knucklebar Pace
description: Drive off the rear leg to carry the sabre arm forward into the target's space.

name: Dishdrop
description: Follow the curve of the blade with the wrist so the cut flows round the target's guard.

name: Swathebump
description: Swing the blade in a crescent and chop where its arc ends with qi at the edge.

name: Flat Brush
description: Draw the inner curve of the blade across the target slowly with qi held along it.

name: Downward Ringpommel
description: Hook the outer curve behind a foe's weapon arm and pull it to open the guard.

name: Dishwedge
description: Cradle an incoming blade in the hollow of the curve and hold it with a pulse of qi.

name: Skipping Spineback
description: Step in a crescent path that slips outside the foe's reach while the blade follows.

name: Resting Dishguard
description: Turn the curve against an incoming weapon so it rolls off the belly and past the body.
